launch.banner.headline: Everything was already in place, so {gameName} is starting now
launch.checking.hint: This can take a moment on a large game.
launch.checking.title: Checking your files…
launch.checks.clean: No new changes in your game files or saves
launch.checks.cleanInstall: No new changes in your game files
launch.checks.install: Game version and mods: already on {state}
launch.checks.installPlain: Game version and mods: already match this profile
launch.checks.title: What SavePoint checked
launch.dialog.discardMessage: {role, select, install {The game install folder} external {The saves folder} other {The folder}} ({path}) goes back to its last snapshot.{role, select, external { Progress you saved in the game since then is lost.} other {}}
launch.dialog.discardRemoves: {count, plural, one {# new file is deleted.} other {# new files are deleted.}}
launch.dialog.discardRestores: {count, plural, one {# changed file is put back as it was.} other {# changed files are put back as they were.}}
launch.dialog.dontAskAgain: Skip this check when only your saves change
launch.dialog.keepExplain: These changes don't belong to any profile. They came from playing an older snapshot, or from a profile you deleted. Keep them as a new profile so nothing is lost.
launch.dialog.olderPoint: This is an older snapshot of "{profileName}". After you play, you can keep the session as a new profile, or continue "{profileName}" from it, which removes its newer snapshots from it.
launch.dialog.saveCaption: This replaces what's in your saves folder right now.
launch.dialog.savingFirst: Taking a snapshot of these changes…
launch.dialog.saveFirstFailed: SavePoint couldn't take a snapshot of these changes. {reason}
launch.dialog.saveSubtitle: {count, plural, one {# save snapshot} other {# save snapshots}} in this profile
launch.dialog.saveSubtitleRecent: Latest · {count, plural, one {# save snapshot} other {# save snapshots}} in this profile
launch.dialog.subtitle: Here's exactly what SavePoint will change before the game starts.
launch.dialog.title: Switch to "{profileName}"?
launch.dialog.unfinishedBody: {role, select, install {The game install folder} external {The saves folder} other {A folder}} has a mix of files from two snapshots. Finish the switch to carry on, or discard the mix to go back to the snapshot it started from.
launch.dialog.unsavedBody: {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} in {role, select, install {the game's folder} external {your saves folder} other {this folder}} changed since the last snapshot of "{ownerName}". Take a snapshot to keep them there, or discard them.
launch.dialog.unsavedBodyUnowned: {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} in {role, select, install {the game's folder} external {your saves folder} other {this folder}} changed since the last snapshot. Keep them as a new profile, or discard them.
launch.dialog.unsavedTitle: New changes since the last snapshot
launch.dialog.versionReplaced: About {size} of files will be replaced.
launch.dialog.versionSentence: Going from {from}, {direction, select, back {back to} other {to}} {target}.
launch.failure.heldBody: Something else on your computer is holding one of the game's files open. Close the game, its launcher and any mod manager, then try again. Nothing has been changed.
launch.failure.heldTitle: A file is in use, so the switch didn't start
launch.keep.body: SavePoint takes a snapshot of your game folders as they are now and makes it a new profile, so nothing is lost. You can play it any time.
launch.keep.partial: Only part of that was kept. {reason} Your new changes are still in your game folders. Try again, or discard them.
launch.keep.title: Keep as a new profile
launch.keptAsNew.body: {folder, select, install {Your game version and mods} external {Your saves} other {Your game folders}} didn't end with the snapshot you chose to replace, so SavePoint added this session there as a new snapshot instead. The other snapshots there are as they were.
launch.keptAsNew.title: Kept as a new snapshot
launch.leftAlone.body: {folder, select, install {Your game version and mods weren't} external {Your saves weren't} other {Your game folders weren't}} included, because you played them from another profile's snapshot. Anything that changed in them is still in your game folders, and SavePoint asks about it the next time you play.
launch.leftAlone.title: Part of that session isn't in the snapshot
launch.partial.body: {saved, select, install {Your game version and mods are in the snapshot. Your saves aren't yet.} external {Your saves are in the snapshot. Your game version and mods aren't yet.} other {Part of your session is in the snapshot, and part isn't yet.}} {reason} Nothing in your game folders changed. Fix that and retry just that part.
launch.partial.bodyLeftAlone: {failed, select, install {Your game version and mods aren't in the snapshot yet.} other {Your saves aren't in the snapshot yet.}} {reason} {left, select, install {Your game version and mods weren't} external {Your saves weren't} other {Your game folders weren't}} included, because you played them from another profile's snapshot. Nothing in your game folders changed, and SavePoint asks about any changes there the next time you play. Fix that and retry just that part.
launch.partial.retry: {role, select, install {Retry the version and mods} other {Retry the saves}}
launch.partial.title: Only part of the snapshot was taken
launch.partial.titleNothingSaved: SavePoint couldn't take a snapshot of that session
launch.postPlay.body: {count, plural, =0 {SavePoint found no new or changed saves to keep. What should it do with this session?} one {# file in your saves folder is new or changed since you started. What should SavePoint do with it?} other {# files in your saves folder are new or changed since you started. What should SavePoint do with them?}}
launch.postPlay.choicesLabel: What to do with this session
launch.postPlay.fork.sub: Recommended. "{profileName}" stays exactly as it is, newer snapshots included, and this session starts a profile of its own.
launch.postPlay.fork.title: Keep this session as a new profile
launch.postPlay.installChanged: {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} in the game's own folder also changed while you played, as an update would.
launch.postPlay.move.sub: This session becomes the latest snapshot of "{profileName}". {count, plural, =0 {Nothing is removed from it.} one {Its # newer snapshot is removed from it. It stays in History under "Recently removed" until you next free up space, and you can bring it back as a new profile.} other {Its # newer snapshots are removed from it. They stay in History under "Recently removed" until you next free up space, and you can bring them back as a new profile.}}
launch.postPlay.move.title: Continue "{profileName}" from this session
launch.postPlay.moveConfirm.message: {count, plural, one {# newer snapshot is} other {# newer snapshots are}} removed from "{profileName}". {count, plural, one {It stays} other {They stay}} in History under "Recently removed" until you next free up space, and you can bring {count, plural, one {it} other {them}} back as a new profile until then. After that, {count, plural, one {it is} other {they are}} deleted for good.
launch.postPlay.moveConfirm.title: Continue "{profileName}" from this session?
launch.postPlay.new.sub: Recommended. Your earlier snapshots stay exactly as they are.
launch.postPlay.new.title: Keep this session as a new snapshot
launch.postPlay.olderNote: You played from an older snapshot of "{profileName}", so this session can't simply go on the end of it.
launch.postPlay.skip.sub: Nothing is lost. Your saves stay in your game folders as new changes, and SavePoint asks again before you switch profiles.
launch.postPlay.skip.title: Not now
launch.postPlay.title: You played for {duration}
launch.postPlay.update.sub: What "{pointName}" held before is removed. It stays in History under "Recently removed" until you next free up space, and you can bring it back as a new profile.
launch.postPlay.update.title: Replace "{pointName}" with this session
launch.postPlay.updateConfirm.message: "{pointName}" will hold this session instead. What it held before stays in History under "Recently removed" until you next free up space, and you can bring it back as a new profile. After that, it is deleted for good.
launch.postPlay.updateConfirm.title: Replace this snapshot?
launch.progress.filesSoFar: {done} files put in place so far
launch.progress.hint: This can take a while for a large install, especially if a lot changed.
launch.progress.state.versionAndMods: version {version} and its {count, plural, one {# mod file} other {# mod files}}
launch.progress.stopNote: Stopping leaves the game's folder with a mix of two snapshots. Press Play again and SavePoint finishes the job.
launch.progress.title: Getting {gameName} ready…
launch.running.title: {gameName} is running
launch.saving.hint: SavePoint is copying what's in your game folders now.
launch.saving.title: Taking a snapshot of your session…
launch.state.mods: {version} with {count, plural, one {# mod file} other {# mod files}}
